results.name: Hans Christian Andersen
results.description:
Author Hans Christian Andersen, known as H.C. in Denmark, has been immortalized next to Copenhagen's City Hall. 
Already in 1936 there was a proposal for a statue of Hans Christian Andersen on the City Hall square. 
In 1937 Utzon-Frank won a competition for a memorial for the poet. 
However, the statue was not finished by the artist's death in 1955, and it was Luckow-Nielsen who has taken over.

results.name: Wedding Ring 3D Scan
results.description:
Wedding Ring 3D scanning with the Artec Micro 3D scanner.
Total time to scan: about 30 minutes
Total time to process: about 40 minutes

Final model was simplified/reduced to under 1 million polygons, and then wrapped with collected color data during the 3D scanning process. The shininess of the ring and diamonds cause a lot of texture imperfections which have been left as-is for this model.

Ring design and fabrication by Knox Jewelers in Minneapolis, MN
